data.name: Danae
data.short_meaning: Goddess of the Sea, Sky or Earth
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Danae was a woman of Argos, who was favored by Zeus and was given a golden rain shower as a gift. The name Danae comes from the ancient Greek word 'danaos', which means 'people' or 'race'.
data.spiritual_meaning: Danae represents the divine feminine, the goddess within each of us. She embodies the power and grace of the sea, the nurturing and abundant nature of the earth, and the vastness and mystery of the sky. Danae is a reminder to embrace the divine within ourselves and to trust in the wisdom and guidance of the universe.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Danae: In Greek mythology, Danae was a noblewoman who was condemned to be sealed in a bronze chamber by her jealous brother, Acrisius. God Zeus, in the form of a shower of golden rain, visited her and she gave birth to Perseus, symbolizing the power of divine grace and hope amidst trials and hardships. In Christianity, Danae embodies the faith and perseverance of a woman who, despite being imprisoned by her circumstances, remained open to the grace of God.
